content:
Describes a Cloud Function that contains user computation executed in response to an event. It
encapsulates function and trigger configurations.
JSON representation
Fields
name
string
A user-defined name of the function. Function names must be unique globally and
match pattern projects/*/locations/*/functions/*
{
"name": string,
"description": string,
"buildConfig": {
object (BuildConfig (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#BuildConfig))
},
"serviceConfig": {
object (ServiceConfig (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#ServiceConfig)
},
"eventTrigger": {
object (EventTrigger (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#EventTrigger))
},
"state": enum (State (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#State)),
"updateTime": string,
"labels": {
string: string,
...
},
"stateMessages": [
{
object (StateMessage (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#StateMessag
}
],
"environment": enum (Environment (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#En
"upgradeInfo": {
object (UpgradeInfo (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#UpgradeInfo))
},
"url": string,
"kmsKeyName": string,
"satisfiesPzs": boolean,
"createTime": string,
"satisfiesPzi": boolean
}
Fields
description
string
User-provided description of a function.
buildConfig
object (BuildConfig
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#BuildConfig))
Describes the Build step of the function that builds a container from the given source.
serviceConfig
object (ServiceConfig
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#ServiceConfig))
Describes the Service being deployed. Currently deploys services to Cloud Run (fully
managed).
eventTrigger
object (EventTrigger
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#EventTrigger))
An Eventarc trigger managed by Google Cloud Functions that fires events in response
to a condition in another service.
state
enum (State
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#State))
Output only. State of the function.
updateTime
string (Timestamp
(https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp) format)
Output only. The last update timestamp of a Cloud Function.
Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or
9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: "2014-10-
02T15:01:23Z", "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z" or "2014-10-
02T15:01:23+05:30".
labels
map (key: string, value: string)
Labels associated with this Cloud Function.
An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name":
"wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }.
stateMessages[]
object (StateMessage
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#StateMessage))
Output only. State Messages for this Cloud Function.
environment
enum (Environment
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#Environment))
Describe whether the function is 1st Gen or 2nd Gen.
upgradeInfo
object (UpgradeInfo
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#UpgradeInfo))
Output only. UpgradeInfo for this Cloud Function
url
string
Output only. The deployed url for the function.
kmsKeyName
string
Fields
Resource name of a KMS crypto key (managed by the user) used to encrypt/decrypt
function resources.
It must match the pattern
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring}/cry
ptoKeys/{crypto_key}.
satisfiesPzs
boolean
Output only. Reserved for future use.
createTime
string (Timestamp
(https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp) format)
Output only. The create timestamp of a Cloud Function. This is only applicable to 2nd
Gen functions.
Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or
9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: "2014-10-
02T15:01:23Z", "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z" or "2014-10-
02T15:01:23+05:30".
satisfiesPzi
boolean
Output only. Reserved for future use.
